mentions.name: Personal Journal App
mentions.description: A personal journal app inspired by Diarium and Day One, extended with features missing from those apps: a distraction-free writing mode that hides everything but the words, improved voice-to-text transcription that can be pasted into an entry while keeping the original recording, better picture layouts, and Apple Watch integration for speaking ideas directly from the watch. The app is designed so new features are easy to integrate.
mentions.problem: Existing journal apps like Diarium and Day One are missing features the author wanted, such as a proper writing mode, better voice-to-text transcription, better picture layout, and Apple Watch integration.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on my version of a journal app that is basically Diarium but I can add any features that are missing from Diarium and Day One.

evidence.value: Been working on my version of a journal app that is basically Diarium but I can add any features that are missing from Diarium and Day One.
